docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Nāmaliṅgānuśāsana of Amarasiṃha, known as the Amarakośa: synonyms in verse, grouped by subject (heaven and gods, time, mind and speech, the netherworld and waters; the earth, cities, plants, animals and the four social orders; adjectives, homonyms, indeclinables and genders), with the gender of each word. The Sanskrit text of the three kāṇḍas, the verses numbered by book, section and verse.

From Wikisource · Public domain

Amarasiṃha, Amarakośa: the Sanskrit text as transcribed on Sanskrit Wikisource by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikisource when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: Public domain.
